## Content

- [GA4, Clarity & Event Tracking Implementation](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/analytics-tracking-implementation): How GA4, Microsoft Clarity, and custom event tracking were implemented together as one measurement layer instead of three disconnected tools.
- [AWS Infrastructure Setup for a Media-Heavy SaaS Platform](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/aws-infrastructure-setup-cintegrate): How Cintegrate's backend was built around AWS S3 storage and a containerized deploy path from day one, instead of bolting cloud storage on after launch.
- [Cloudflare Deployment: Building a Secure, Fast, and Reliable Delivery Layer](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/cloudflare-deployment): How DNS, SSL, CDN, and caching were configured together as one edge delivery layer, instead of DNS records and a CDN toggle treated as separate afterthoughts.
- [CMS Integration: Building Flexible Content Management Systems for Modern Websites](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/cms-integration): How CMS choice — Sanity, Payload, or WordPress — is matched to a project's content complexity and technical requirements instead of defaulted to one platform for every build.
- [Email & DNS Infrastructure Foundation Case Study](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/email-dns-infrastructure-foundation): How HA Web Studio treats email deliverability and DNS reliability as part of every website build, not a separate handoff left for the client.
- [Google Business Visibility Foundation Case Study](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/google-business-visibility-foundation): How HA Web Studio pairs Google Business Profile setup with website architecture so local visibility and on-site content stay fully consistent.
- [HA Web Studio Platform Architecture Case Study](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/ha-web-studio-architecture): How HA Web Studio's own site is structured as a connected content system across Services, Work, Technologies, and Insights.
- [Omnivy: A Chrome Extension for Clipping the Web into Obsidian, Notion, and Cloud Storage](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/omnivy-browser-clipper-chrome-extension): Case study on building Omnivy, a Chromium browser extension that turns articles, code, and discussions into clean Markdown and routes it to Obsidian, Notion, Google Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox.
- [Payment Gateway Integration: Creating Secure, Reliable, and Frictionless Online Payment Experiences](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/payment-gateway-integration): How Razorpay and Stripe checkout flows are built around server-side signature verification and webhook handling, so payment confirmation never depends on trusting the client alone.
- [Technical SEO and AI Search Visibility Foundation](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/search-visibility-and-ai-search-foundation): How HA Web Studio built one connected foundation for technical SEO, structured data, and AI search visibility — not two separate efforts.
- [Website Performance Foundation with Next.js](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/website-performance-foundation): Internal case study on how HA Web Studio treats website performance as an architecture decision, not a one-off Core Web Vitals tuning pass.
- [AI Search Optimization: Preparing Your Website for AI-Powered Search](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/ai-search-optimization): Why websites need to be structured for AI systems like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity — not just traditional search rankings.
- [Choosing the Right CMS: WordPress vs Sanity vs Payload CMS](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/choosing-the-right-cms): How CMS fit depends on your content, technical stack, and who's actually editing — not which platform is currently popular.
- [Cloudflare Explained: How a CDN Improves Website Speed, Security, and Reliability](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/cloudflare-explained): What Cloudflare actually does — DNS, CDN, SSL, caching, and security — and why unconfigured Cloudflare barely helps at all.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Turning More Visitors Into Customers](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/conversion-rate-optimization-guide): Why more traffic isn't the fix for a website that struggles to convert the visitors it already has — and what actually moves conversion rate.
- [Understanding DNS, Domains & SSL: A Practical Guide for Business Owners](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/dns-domains-ssl-guide): What actually happens between typing a domain and a page loading — domain, DNS, hosting, SSL, and CDN explained without the jargon.
- [Google Analytics 4: Measuring What Matters on Your Website](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/google-analytics-4): How GA4's event-based model works, what to actually track, and why it's more useful paired with qualitative tools like Microsoft Clarity.
- [How Much Does a Website Cost? A Practical Pricing Guide](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/how-much-does-a-website-cost): A straight answer to what drives website cost — pages, design complexity, CMS, ecommerce, integrations, content, and SEO — so you can budget realistically and compare quotes properly.
- [Microsoft Clarity: Understanding How Visitors Actually Use Your Website](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/microsoft-clarity): How session recordings, heatmaps, and friction signals like rage clicks show what analytics numbers alone can't explain.
- [Choosing the Right Payment Gateway: Razorpay vs Stripe](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/razorpay-vs-stripe): How market and business model — not feature count — should decide between Razorpay and Stripe, illustrated through a real Razorpay integration.
- [Shopify vs WooCommerce: Which Ecommerce Platform Is Right for Your Business?](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/shopify-vs-woocommerce): How platform choice comes down to managed simplicity versus ownership and customization — not which one is more popular.
- [Structured Data & Schema: Helping Search Engines Understand Your Website](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/structured-data-schema): What Schema Markup is, the common types worth implementing, and how it supports both traditional search and AI interpretation.
- [Technical SEO Checklist for Every Business Website](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/technical-seo-checklist): A practical checklist for crawlability, indexability, structure, and metadata — the technical foundation every other SEO effort depends on.
- [Website Launch Checklist: What Every Business Should Do Before Going Live](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/website-launch-checklist): The technical, performance, SEO, analytics, and security review every website needs before launch — and what to monitor in the weeks after.
- [How to Plan a Successful Website Project: A Guide for Business Owners](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/website-project-planning-guide): Why website projects go over budget and past deadline — and the planning steps (goals, structure, content, SEO) that actually prevent it.
- [Website Security Basics: 10 Essentials Every Business Website Should Have](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/website-security-basics): The ten practical safeguards — HTTPS, strong auth, backups, monitoring — that prevent most real-world website security incidents.

- [JavaScript (ES6+)](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/frontend/javascript-es6): HA Web Studio builds interactive, high-performance websites using modern JavaScript (ES6+), the language that powers every dynamic feature on the web.
- [Next.js](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/frontend/nextjs): HA Web Studio builds fast, SEO-friendly websites and web apps on Next.js, combining React's flexibility with server-side rendering built for Google.
- [React](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/frontend/react): HA Web Studio builds fast, component-based websites and web apps with React, the industry-standard library for modern user interfaces.
- [React Hook Form](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/frontend/react-hook-form): HA Web Studio builds fast, reliable forms with React Hook Form, reducing errors and friction on the pages that generate your leads.
- [shadcn/ui](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/frontend/shadcn-ui): HA Web Studio builds accessible, polished interfaces faster using shadcn/ui, a component system built on React, Tailwind CSS, and Radix.
- [Tailwind CSS](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/frontend/tailwind-css): HA Web Studio uses Tailwind CSS to build custom, on-brand websites quickly, without the bloat of pre-built themes or generic templates.
- [TypeScript](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/frontend/typescript): HA Web Studio builds websites and applications in TypeScript for fewer bugs, safer code, and long-term maintainability as your project grows.
- [Zod](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/frontend/zod): HA Web Studio uses Zod to validate data across forms and APIs, preventing bad data and errors before they reach your database.
- [Application Infrastructure](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure): Supporting infrastructure for authentication, storage, queues, monitoring, cache, and application reliability.
- [AWS (Amazon Web Services)](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/aws): HA Web Studio uses AWS for projects that need specific cloud infrastructure, storage, or scale beyond standard managed hosting platforms.
- [Better Auth / Auth.js](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/better-auth-authjs): HA Web Studio implements secure login and account systems using Better Auth or Auth.js, giving your website reliable, safe user authentication.
- [Clerk](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/clerk): HA Web Studio integrates Clerk for fast, fully managed user authentication, complete with pre-built login screens and account management.
- [ImageKit / Cloudinary](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/imagekit-cloudinary): HA Web Studio uses ImageKit and Cloudinary to automatically optimize, resize, and deliver images fast, directly improving page speed.
- [Neon](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/neon): HA Web Studio uses Neon for serverless PostgreSQL hosting, giving projects a scalable, modern database without manual server management.
- [RabbitMQ](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/rabbitmq): HA Web Studio uses RabbitMQ to reliably manage background tasks and communication between services in more complex applications.
- [Redis](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/redis): HA Web Studio uses Redis to make websites and applications faster through in-memory caching, session storage, and rate limiting.
- [Sentry](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/sentry): HA Web Studio integrates Sentry to catch and alert on website errors in real time, often before your customers even notice a problem.
- [UploadThing](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/uploadthing): HA Web Studio uses UploadThing to handle file and image uploads on websites simply and reliably, without building storage infrastructure from scratch.
- [Upstash](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/infrastructure/upstash): HA Web Studio uses Upstash to add serverless Redis and messaging to modern applications without managing infrastructure directly.
- [SEO & Analytics](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/seo-analytics): Measurement and search visibility technologies for crawlability, reporting, and structured understanding.
- [Bing Webmaster Tools](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/seo-analytics/bing-webmaster-tools): HA Web Studio sets up Bing Webmaster Tools so your site is properly indexed and visible beyond just Google search results.
- [Google Analytics 4](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/seo-analytics/google-analytics-4): HA Web Studio sets up Google Analytics 4 correctly from day one, so you can actually trust the data driving your marketing decisions.
- [Google Search Console](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/seo-analytics/google-search-console): HA Web Studio sets up and monitors Google Search Console to track how your site performs in search and catch indexing issues early.
- [Lighthouse](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/seo-analytics/lighthouse): HA Web Studio uses Google Lighthouse to measure and improve site speed, accessibility, and SEO, the technical factors that directly affect rankings.
- [Microsoft Clarity](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/seo-analytics/microsoft-clarity): HA Web Studio integrates Microsoft Clarity to show exactly how visitors behave on your site through free session recordings and heatmaps.
- [Schema.org](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/seo-analytics/schema-org): HA Web Studio implements Schema.org structured data so search engines and AI tools understand your content clearly and show it in rich results.
- [Cintegrate: AI-Assisted Video Creation Platform](https://hawebstudio.com/work/cintegrate): An AI-assisted platform that turns a story idea into structured scenes, narration, and finished video output through one connected pipeline.
- [HA UI Design System: Reusable Component Library](https://hawebstudio.com/work/ha-ui-design-system): An internal design system project focused on reusable, accessible components that keep every HA Web Studio build consistent and fast to ship.
- [Building the HA Web Studio Marketing Platform](https://hawebstudio.com/work/ha-web-studio-website): The connected marketing platform powering HA Web Studio's services, solutions, work, and publishing workflows in one structured Next.js system.
- [MS Signature Scents: Ecommerce Storefront Build](https://hawebstudio.com/work/ms-signature-scents): A full-stack ecommerce storefront for a fine attar fragrance brand, featuring a CMS-driven catalogue, wishlist, and verified Razorpay checkout.
- [Omnivy: Browser Web Clipper for Markdown Notes](https://hawebstudio.com/work/omnivy-web-clipper): A browser-first web clipper that turns any page into clean, editable Markdown and saves it straight into Obsidian, Notion, or your cloud drive.
